Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in while turning left in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state the location where the collision occurred.
A: It was at a busy interseciton in Katy, on a main road with a traffic signal. I was turning left into a shopping center.
Q: What was the signal showing when you began your turn?
A: It was a green arrow for me, I'm fairly sure. The oncoming traffic had a red light.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I saw headlights when I was partway through the turn, but I didn't have time to react before we hit.
Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?
A: The front passenger side of my car was hit by the other vehicle's front end.
Q: Were you injured in the collision?
A: Yes. My lower back hurts quite a bit. It feels tight and sore, especially when I sit for a long time or get up from a
chair.
Q: Have you sought medical attention?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They examined me, took some X-rays, and told me I had a back
strain. They gave me medication and told me to rest and do some gentle stretching.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: I missed two days and I've been working lighter duties since then.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping to get my car repaired and my back feeling better.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any

- "reason": one short sentence.
